_measurement_context.result_convention: headline min/max are the range of the three process medians; all-sample min/max are retained separately
_measurement_context.timing_runs: 3 independent processes per condition; 1 untimed warmup and 7 timed samples in each process

diagnostic_build.build: QA-only interpreter/JIT diagnostics, release NDEBUG; excluded from timing

method: Each case was run in three fresh pinned processes with the QA-only RuntimeStatsEngine counters. One full call warmed hotspot detection, idle_hook(32) serviced compilation, then counters were reset before the measured guest call. No diagnostic run was timed.
note: The queue can auto-compile when full during the warmup boundary; therefore idle_hook may return zero after traces are already resident. Resident trace PCs and subsequent trace execution counters prove compilation and use.

counter_definitions.interpreter_steps: RuntimeStatsEngine.stat_interp_steps; interpreted basic-block dispatch count, not WASM opcode count.
counter_definitions.reentries_per_leaf_call: dispatcher_trace_transitions divided by n calls from bench_direct/bench_indirect to leaf.
counter_definitions.trace_exits_per_leaf_call: trace_exits_to_interp divided by n calls from bench_direct/bench_indirect to leaf; this is a scheduler-boundary measure, not all internal trace exit edges.
counter_definitions.trace_exits_to_interp: RuntimeStatsEngine.stat_trace_exits_to_interp; scheduler boundaries returned to the interpreter.
